ambiguities.text: The blob schedule specifies exact epochs (412672, 419072) but the specification does not clarify behavior if the schedule is empty or if queried for an epoch before the first entry.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume fallback to MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK_ELECTRA when no Fulu schedule entries apply, as stated in get_blob_parameters. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: The proposer_lookahead vector size is (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1) * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH but MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD is noted as 1, making the vector 2 * 32 = 64 slots. The shift/append semantics across epoch boundaries need careful implementation.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume exactly SLOTS_PER_EPOCH entries are shifted out and SLOTS_PER_EPOCH new entries appended at each epoch boundary. This is an assumption.

implicit_assumptions.description: All nodes on the network have the same BLOB_SCHEDULE configuration, ensuring consistent fork digest computation.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes with different blob schedules would compute different fork digests, partitioning the network unintentionally.

implicit_assumptions.description: The proposer lookahead is computed deterministically from beacon state, so all honest nodes agree on proposer assignments.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Proposer disagreements could cause fork divergence or missed slots.

implicit_assumptions.description: Blob schedule epoch thresholds are set far enough in advance for all nodes to upgrade before activation.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes running old software would reject valid blocks with higher blob counts, causing a chain split.
